# HTML Element Nesting Pairs — Full Exhaustive List

Every individual parent → child pair on its own line, with UA default CSS.
**116 elements × 116 elements = 13456 pairs.**

Format per entry:
```
N. `<parent> → <child>` = **ACTION** — behavior note
   parent CSS: {ua defaults}  |  child CSS: {ua defaults}  |  context: {formatting context}
```

## `<fieldset>` (rule: FLOW_PARENT)
UA default: `display:block; border:2px groove; padding:0.35em 0.75em 0.625em; margin-inline:2px; min-inline-size:min-content`

## `<th>` (rule: TABLE_CELL_PARENT)
UA default: `display:table-cell; padding:1px; font-weight:bold; text-align:center; vertical-align:inherit`

## `<tr>` (rule: TABLE_ROW_PARENT)
UA default: `display:table-row; vertical-align:inherit; border-color:inherit`
Children context: TFC row context

12645. `<tr> → <a>` = **FOSTER** — Foster parenting. Non-table content moved BEFORE the table ancestor in DOM.
   parent CSS: `display:table-row; vertical-align:inherit; border-color:inherit` | child CSS: `display:inline; color:linkcolor; text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer` | context: TFC row context
